Payments

Polk County is set to recieve approximately $3.21M over the course of the settlement.

Spending Plans

Local governments must approve and share spending plans before spending opioid settlement funds. Governments may not spend more than the approved amounts (though they may spend less).

Polk County has not shared any spending plans. Visit the Document Library to see all of Polk County’s spending plans.

Polk County has not authorized the use of any settlement funds.

Collaborative Strategic Planning Report and Recommendations

Local governments that wish to spend opioid settlement funds on any Exhibit B strategies must first engage in the Collaborative Strategic Planning process, resulting in a report and recommendations to the local governming board. This process is not required to fund Exhibit A strategies.

Polk County has not submitted any report and recommendations documents.

Visit the Document Library to see all Collaborative Strategic Planning reports.

Past Spending

Polk County has not reported spending any settlement funds.

Annual Settlement Update

Polk County has not shared any strategy-specific narratives.

Visit the Document Library to see all narrative documents from Polk County.

Local governments are at varying stages of implementing opioid settlement strategies. For each opioid settlement funded strategy, local governments were asked to select their State of Implementation from a list of five options:

  • Exploration and Planning
  • Preparation
  • Initial Implementation
  • Full Implementation
  • Further Expansion

This information helps describe the impact of the strategy activities during a given year. (Note that this information was not required and some local governments have chosen not to provide this information.)

Polk County did not share any implementation stage information with us.
